name: Cfx Server (Windows, Wine)
author: tom.grobbe@gmail.com
description: Runs the Cfx for GTA V Enhanced Windows server (cfx-server.exe) under Wine on Linux. The base server is pulled from the Cfx depot 'main' channel, while everything inside coreclr_server is replaced with the 'csharp_improvements' build.

variables.name: Server channel
variables.description: Cfx depot channel the server binaries come from. 'main' is the current Enhanced release.

variables.name: C# runtime channel
variables.description: Cfx depot channel that the coreclr_server folder is taken from, overwriting the one from the server channel.

variables.name: Download default resources
variables.description: Download the cfx-server-data resources on a fresh install. Skipped when a resources folder already exists.

variables.name: License key
variables.description: Cfx license key from https://portal.cfx.re/. Only written into server.cfg when the installer creates that file, edit server.cfg to change it later.

variables.name: Virtual display
variables.description: Start a virtual X display (Xvfb) before the server. Only needed if something you run wants a desktop, leave at 0 otherwise.
